subject.title: WhatsApp 1:1: inbound image wedges main lane ~3min before processing — multimodal run strands active_reply_work/queued_work_without_active_run (repro on 2026.6.10, post-#95039)

question: Should WhatsApp/image lanes treat terminal run:completed plus stale active_reply_work and queued work as releasable recovery state, or should OpenClaw preserve the current active-reply-work guard until stronger liveness proof exists?
rationale: The source path is clear, but the recovery policy trades off message-lane availability against aborting real active multimodal work, and related fixes only cover adjacent ownerless or replay cases.

options.title: Require live proof, then narrow release
options.body: Reproduce the WhatsApp image wedge on current main and add a narrow release path for terminal stale active reply work with regression coverage.

options.title: Wait for replay work
options.body: Keep this blocked on #97538/#99365 if maintainers believe the durable replay fix will also eliminate the stale claim symptoms.

options.title: Preserve current guard
options.body: Close as not planned only if maintainers decide active reply work must never be force-released without a stronger live-run liveness signal.

recommendation.title: Require live proof, then narrow release
recommendation.body: Reproduce the WhatsApp image wedge on current main and add a narrow release path for terminal stale active reply work with regression coverage.

likelyOwner.reason: They most recently changed the same diagnostic recovery decision tree for an adjacent stuck-lane class.
